payload.title: Browse Papyrus record types without collapsing them into stories
payload.description:
Feature: Type-aware Papyrus record browsing
Scenario: See all actual base record models
Given the current Papyrus schema
When I browse records by domain, type, or text
Then every persistent base model is discoverable with meaningful labels and actual schema fields
And synthetic examples disclose that no live backend mapping is connected
Scenario: Reference curation lifecycle
Given a synthetic reference with an actual curation status
When I change its curation status and reload
Then the local preview store preserves the status and reason
Scenario: Non-workflow records
Given an attachment, relationship, identity, or publication copy
When I open its list and detail
Then no story stage controls or invented workflow is presented
And the original story board and priming remain functional
